isolation.method: Two independent player contexts claim Varis and Druk. Both browser CPUs throttled before initial campaign load and throughout six alternating real drags (three per player). GPU/accelerated Canvas2D disabled, WebGL blocked. Node server unrestricted on same host. No network delay or RAM cap. Event-driven draw/SVG probes, two RAF paint opportunities; captures pointer-release to local committed token and sight update. Wire bytes from CDP websocket frames (no browser instrumentation loop). Recording adds overhead. CPU totals from Node process.cpuUsage include worker threads.

cleanProfile.method: CDP sampled JavaScript profiles: self time by leaf sample, inclusive time includes descendants and must not be summed across functions. Trace durations are inclusive event time and may overlap/nest. Profiles add overhead and CPU throttling affects wall-clock sampled durations.

rasterization.method: Unthrottled Node/Sharp rasterization of one actual captured player mask. 2 warmups then 7 sequential samples per size/format. Includes SVG parsing, rasterization and image encoding; excludes network, client decoding and display. Lower resolutions are a prototype quality tradeoff, not a production visibility policy.

display.method: Installed Chrome, 20x CPU slowdown, GPU and accelerated Canvas2D disabled. Binary Blob prepared before timer; 5 new Image/Blob-URL samples per static mask. Timed image.decode plus two RAF display opportunities. Excludes network, Socket.IO, app state, token work and data deserialization. Repeated image content can benefit from browser caches; these are isolated display feasibility measurements, not end-to-end app latency.
